text: cloud-gpu-openmm-fep-provisioning-confirmed: hexa cloud should pin openmm cuda-version<=driver CUDA (cap 12.4), ensure bzip2 before micromamba untar, add preflight --kind openmm smoke + vast verified reliability>0.985 rent filter [migrated from inbox/patches/cloud-gpu-openmm-fep-provisioning-confirmed.md]

cloud-idle-reap-consult-provider-status: cloud idle-reap classifier should consult provider instance status (vast actual_status/runpod desiredStatus) — exited/stopped -> REAP regardless of ssh probe (else lingers as BUSY-UNMANIFESTED) [migrated from inbox/patches/cloud-idle-reap-consult-provider-status.md]

cloud-resume-phin-fildyn-outdir-normalize: hexa cloud --resume normalizes scf.in outdir but not ph.in fildyn/fildvscf -> abs-path q_points crash; normalize to deck-relative [migrated from inbox/patches/cloud-resume-phin-fildyn-outdir-normalize.md]

codegen-isfinite-userfn-collision-clang: selfhost codegen: user-defined fn isfinite/isnan/isinf/signbit collide with C <math.h> macros -> clang errors; namespace/rename user fns that shadow libc math macros [migrated from inbox/patches/codegen-isfinite-userfn-collision-clang.md]

dft-run-direct-endpoint-scp255: dft-run direct-endpoint scp-255 on proxy-only vast offers re-picks the same broken offer; needs proxy-fallback + in-campaign offer blacklist (direct_port_count not a reliable scp proxy) [migrated from inbox/patches/dft-run-direct-endpoint-scp255.md]

dft-run-resume-unconditional-recover-corrupt: dft-run self-resume uses recover=.true. unconditionally; corrupt ph.x recover file fails all 8 cycles -> needs no-recover fallback after N fails + per-q scratch reset [migrated from inbox/patches/dft-run-resume-unconditional-recover-corrupt.md]

hexa-run-buildcache-transitive-imports-not-keyed: hexa run build-cache keys on entry file content only, not transitive imports -> stale cached binary on imported-module edit; also cold-cache rc=-1 race on nested hexa run [migrated from inbox/patches/hexa-run-buildcache-transitive-imports-not-keyed.md]

hexa-run-cache-dep-graph-staleness: hexa run build-cache keys on entry-file hash only -> stale binary on dep edit (correctness footgun); fold transitively-used module hashes into cache key OR add --fresh/HEXA_NO_CACHE escape hatch [migrated from inbox/patches/hexa-run-cache-dep-graph-staleness.md]

hexa-run-import-resolver-argv0-before-stdlib-root: hexa run/build import resolver pushes install_dir_from_argv0() before HEXA_STDLIB_ROOT -> module-not-found from non-hexa-lang cwd; read HEXA_STDLIB_ROOT/HEXA_LANG before install-dir fallback [migrated from inbox/patches/hexa-run-import-resolver-argv0-before-stdlib-root.md]

nvptx-atomic-add-3arg-reg-decl: nvptx codegen 3-arg gpu_atomic_add reuses %rd_idxs_addr without declaring it in .reg block -> ptxas Unknown symbol; emit fresh SSA reg or mirror store-path declaration [migrated from inbox/patches/nvptx-atomic-add-3arg-reg-decl.md]

pool-host-stale-generated-artifacts-after-pull: pool-host qforge blocked by stale gitignored generated artifacts (self/runtime.c, build/hexat) after git pull -> clang/SEGV; hexa selfcheck/pull-hook should refresh/invalidate + auto-prefer build/runtime.a [migrated from inbox/patches/pool-host-stale-generated-artifacts-after-pull.md]

rtsc-vast-gpu-pod-runs-cpu-only-qe: RTSC el-ph rents vast GPU pods but runs CPU-only QE 6.7 (ph.x has no GPU until QE 7.2); add explicit CPU-first/GPU-fallback rent tier to cut $/job (do NOT add GPU-QE to provision) [migrated from inbox/patches/rtsc-vast-gpu-pod-runs-cpu-only-qe.md]

runpod-self-teardown-graphql-not-runpodctl-pod: pod self-teardown must use RunPod GraphQL podTerminate not 'runpodctl pod' (no such subcommand -> silent fail, ~$44 idle burn); add exit-status logging + retry + host-side DONE-but-burning poller [migrated from inbox/patches/runpod-self-teardown-graphql-not-runpodctl-pod.md]

runtime-malloc-macro-clang18-glibc239: self/runtime.c malloc-shim macros collide with <malloc.h> on clang-18/glibc-2.39 runtime.o cache-miss -> 10 clang errors; move system includes above shim macros or guard with #undef, or ship prebuilt runtime.o [migrated from inbox/patches/runtime-malloc-macro-clang18-glibc239.md]

vast-new-instance-rejects-all-ssh-keys: vast newly-created instances reject all registered SSH keys (no account default:true key injected at boot); hexa cloud needs post-rent reachability gate w/ runpod fallback + enforce vast default key + onstart authorized_keys injection [migrated from inbox/patches/vast-new-instance-rejects-all-ssh-keys.md]

pool host summer: hexa decode fails — missing compiled stage1 module_loader (substrate-wall infra, 2026-06-17). pool 호스트에서 module_loader.c 미컴파일 → decode 실패. RT-NATIVE x86_64 pair-model(#3462)과 동일 module_loader 영역. summer 빌드 재생성/캐시 무효화 필요

hexa-lang RT-NATIVE-ZEROC M5-alloc-b2 — self/rt/alloc.hexa 재작성. b1 DONE(F-M5-ALLOC-B1-MULTIPOOL-RAN): multipool raw-mem arena PoC RUN exit0 검증됨(scripts/scratch/rt_native/multipool_arena_poc.hexa, global-free, state in table region). b2=그 검증된 본문을 self/rt/alloc.hexa 에 반영: (1)struct Arena{pools:[ArenaPool]}+arena_grow new_pools.push()+len(pools) → raw-mem table(tbl int, np at header, pool i at tbl+24+i*24, __hx_ptr_load64/store64) (2)__mem_store64/load64(P7-7 옛이름, self/codegen/memop.hexa만 lowering·출하 backend 모름) → __hx_ptr_store64/load64 (3)runtime.c-compat surface(hexa_arena_on/mark/rewind/reset·hexa_ptr_alloc/free)=arena_*(tbl,..) thin wrapper, tbl 은 rt_init 보유. 게이트=C-diff gate alloc_arena_gate.c(N bump/mark/rewind/reset byte-exact vs C arena)+nm non-circular witness, aiden RAN. alloc.hexa=dormant(byteeq-inert, 안전 WIP). 주의=module-global let mut int→g0 undefined(b1 발견), 글로벌 회피. 다음 b3=native rt_*.o M5 standalone-relink(larm64_flatten M5a #3497)→write #else 드롭. 병렬레버=r3 map_*. 룰: subagent 금지·빌드 aiden·mini=git/gh/편집만. 참고=.verdicts/rt-native-byteeq/F-M5-ALLOC-B1-MULTIPOOL-RAN.txt

hexa-lang RT-NATIVE-ZEROC M5-gslot — b2 gate green 의 마지막 1 blocker. M5-syscall-a/b/c DONE(syscall.hexa 출하 leaf 포팅 완료: __hx_target_os+__hx_syscall6+__hx_str_ptr). b2 gate(scripts/scratch/rt_native/alloc_b2_gate.hexa) emit rc=0+as rc=0, link rc=1 =  undefined. 원인: alloc.hexa __arena_tbl(module-global let mut int)이 standalone single-module emit(_drv+1file)에서 g0 로 참조되나 .bss/.data 슬롯 미정의(whole-program 컴파일러 빌드는 data section 공급, 단독 emit 안함). 해결(M5-gslot, codegen/emit 작업): 출하 backend 가 standalone emit 시 참조된 module-global 마다 .bss/.data 슬롯+ label(8B zero-init) 정의. 또는 rt_init 이 유일 writer 인 global 은 const-fold. 위치=compiler/emit/elf_x86_64.hexa(data/bss section) + macho(arm64). ADD-only/emit-shape=컴파일러 self-emit 는 자체 data section 보유→byteeq 보존(CI byteeq-real 권위). 게이트=b2 gate aiden aprime 재빌드 → --emit=asm x86_64 → as → gcc(runtime.o+rt_hi+map_core+array_core.o) → LINK+RUN exit0(rt_init+3 cross-pool hexa_ptr_alloc+mark/rewind/reset)+cross-emit arm64. 이후 b3=standalone-relink(native rt_*.o)→write #else 드롭=ls 감소. 룰: subagent 금지·빌드 aiden·mini=git/gh/편집만. 참고=.verdicts/rt-native-byteeq/F-M5-SYSCALL-C-PTRADDR.txt, compiler/emit/elf_x86_64.hexa
